derivations.reason: A decoded GS1 barcode carries lot "LOT119722" but no extracted line item does - a product is on the page with no row: its barcode decoded while its printed text did not reach the reading (a sticker pasted rotated, or a block the page reading dropped). Added the row from the machine-read barcode.

Line item 22 was recovered from a barcode the extraction had no row for. Its lot and expiry are machine-read and certain; its product name and REF are not in the reading, so any value shown for them is unconfirmed - review them.
